bias.en: Bearish · lost the 100-day and the $226.5 lows
bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 100 日均线和 $226.5 低点

read.en: Marvell fell 8.7% on Oct 22 to $223.47, trading between $220.21 and $236.20. It is below the falling 5-day ($234.7) and 10-day ($247.0) and the rising 30-day ($253.3) and 100-day ($241.9) averages, but above the rising 200-day ($178.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($261.53), and RSI is 38.
read.zh: Marvell 10月22日下跌 8.7%，收于 $223.47，盘中区间 $220.21–236.20。股价位于下行的 5 日（$234.7）和 10 日（$247.0）以及上行的 30 日（$253.3）和 100 日均线（$241.9）下方，仍在上行的 200 日均线（$178.8）上方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，且在零轴之下；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$261.53），RSI 为 38。

read.en: The drop gave back the 100-day average and broke the $226.5 Oct 16 and Oct 20 lows, both now resistance. Resistance is $226.5, then $234.7–242 (5 and 100-day) and $247–250 (10-day, Oct 21 high). Support is $220.2 (Oct 22 low), then $200–200.6 (Sep 1 low). A close above $226.5 would target $234.7–242; a close below $220 would open $200.6.

r.en: Oct 16 and Oct 20 lows, now resistance
